record.title: Establish a specimen-derived guest baseline for entitlement tests
record.intent: Determine whether stock specimen application bytes can expose coherent identity and option state in the existing disposable harness.
requirements: Use a disposable guest overlay and copied unit files with a frozen pre-run manifest. Keep acquired originals and stock APK/native bytes unchanged; pin guest image, fixture versions and copied-file provenance privately.

Reuse established harness evidence for byte-identical binaries. Execute one bounded baseline at the ordinary interface identified by static recovery; do not require full factory-image boot or rediscover deterministic ADC writes.

Record actual model identity, capability and option state wherever the stock interface reaches them. Mark synthetic hardware responses and unavailable values explicitly; do not promote partial initialization into a valid entitlement baseline.

Stop at the first externally unsatisfied dependency or stock error. Preserve file deltas and invocation results, then evaluate deliberately. Do not install options or apply the D redirect during the baseline task.
No physical instrument access. If a physical observation would materially resolve the blocker, record the exact bench question instead of inventing a response.
acceptance: A reproducible pre-install guest baseline or bounded failure with the next dependency is preserved.
